{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2017}}
{{main|2017 World Table Tennis Championships}}

[[Ma Long (table tennis)|Ma Long]] successfully defended his title by defeating [[Fan Zhendong]] 7–11, 11–6, 11–3, 11–8, 5–11, 7–11, 12–10 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/2017/06/05/press-release-olympic-champion-ma-long-defends-title-ittf-world-championships/|title=Press Release: Olympic Champion MA Long Defends Title at ITTF World Championships|date=5 June 2017|work=ittf.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2705&Singles=1 |title=Entry list |website= |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170512072320/http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2705&Singles=1 |archive-date=2017-05-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 7 games in qualification and in the 128-player sized main draw.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |title=Playing system |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170329113132/http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |archive-date=2017-03-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://d3mjm6zw6cr45s.cloudfront.net/2016/11/2017_WTTC_MS.pdf |title=Seeds |access-date=2017-05-27 |archive-date=2017-08-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170810105008/http://d3mjm6zw6cr45s.cloudfront.net/2016/11/2017_WTTC_MS.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>
